environmentRepair.cause: Parent Codex desktop runtime identity variables inherited by the optional external app-server made commandExecution choose a registered Core launcher belonging to the parent app. ADE is not that registered desktop app.
environmentRepair.fix: Remove inherited CODEX_* identity/routing values except CODEX_HOME; remove inherited SHELL when parent desktop identity markers are present. Preserve HOME, USERPROFILE and managed CLI authentication location. No subscription token extraction or global sandbox/config changes.

zeroInferenceNativeExec.extraFlagNote: The final probe sanitizedParent=false field denotes that its redundant --clean-parent diagnostic flag was absent; the compiled transport already applies the production environment filtering. It does not mean filtering was disabled.

environmentRepair.diagnosticFixtureCorrection: QTemporaryDir creates a restricted scratch ACL unavailable to the external Windows sandbox account. The final synthetic scratch used normal inherited ACL via exclusive QDir mkdir. No real user directory ACL, sandbox permission profile, or global configuration was changed.
